title: Seimei Shrine
scope: The 1905 Seimei Shrine main sanctuary and the attached worship frontage in the western precinct, including the front gabled canopy and adjoining low wings.
limitations: Exterior of the main shrine and attached worship frontage only. The separately mapped torii, auxiliary shrines, gift office, precinct sculptures and interiors remain outside the asset.
The combined building footprint and steps establish the model plan and facing. Heights, roof transition and smaller woodwork are visually estimated from the cleared front views.
